description: Get one endpoint in full: description, parameters, headers, request body, saved response examples and its current `version`. Identify it by endpoint_id or by method + path.

endpoint_id.description: Id of the endpoint. Alternative to method + path.

method.description: HTTP method of the route, e.g. POST. Use with path instead of endpoint_id.

path.description: Route path as written in the code, e.g. /v1/charges/:id or /v1/charges/{id}.

name: get_api_endpoint
